crossRefs.note: Don’t think to yourselves, ‘We have Abraham for our father,’ for I tell you that God is able to raise up children to…
“Even now the ax lies at the root of the trees. Therefore every tree that doesn’t produce good fruit is cut down, and…
I tell you that many will come from the east and the west, and will sit down with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob in the…
but the children of the Kingdom will be thrown out into the outer darkness. There will be weeping and gnashing of…
But many will be last who are first; and first who are last.
So the last will be first, and the first last. For many are called, but few are chosen.”
But what do you think? A man had two sons, and he came to the first, and said, ‘Son, go work today in my vineyard.’
But many who are first will be last; and the last first.”

translations.web: Behold, there are some who are last who will be first, and there are some who are first who will be last.”
translations.bsb: And indeed, some who are last will be first, and some who are first will be last.”
translations.kjv: And, behold, there are last which shall be first, and there are first which shall be last.
translations.asv: And behold, there are last who shall be first, and there are first who shall be last.
